```yaml
name: Agent Board Integration and Autonomous Worker

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 */15 * * *'  # Run every 15 minutes

jobs:
  agentic-worker:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          components: rustfmt, clippy

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential libssl-dev libffi-dev

      - name: Setup Environment Variables
        run: |
          echo "GITHUB_PROJECTS_TOKEN=${{ secrets.GITHUB_PROJECTS_TOKEN }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "GITHUB_TOKEN=${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "GITHUB_REPOSITORY=${{ github.repository }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "GITHUB_RUN_ID=${{ github.run_id }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Run Unit Tests
        run: |
          cargo test --workspace --verbose

      - name: Run Agentic Kanban Worker
        run: |
          cargo run --bin agentic-kanban-worker
        env:
          GITHUB_PROJECTS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_PROJECTS_TOKEN }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          GITHUB_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          GITHUB_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}

      - name: Validate Board Integration
        run: |
          cargo test board_integration --verbose

      - name: Check Formatting
        run: |
          cargo fmt --check

      - name: Clippy Linting
        run: |
          cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings

      - name: Upload Artifacts
        if: success()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: agentic-worker-logs
          path: |
            target/debug/agentic-kanban-worker
            logs/
          retention-days: 7

  integration-tests:
    needs: agentic-worker
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable

      - name: Run Integration Tests
        run: |
          cargo test integration --verbose
        env:
          GITHUB_PROJECTS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_PROJECTS_TOKEN }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  security-checks:
    needs: agentic-worker
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run Security Audit
        run: |
          cargo audit

      - name: Check for Sensitive Data
        run: |
          grep -r "GITHUB_" . --exclude-dir=target --exclude-dir=.git || true

  docker-build:
    needs: agentic-worker
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Build Docker Image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          file: ./Dockerfile
          push: false
          tags: |
            ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}/agentic-worker:latest
            ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}/agentic-worker:${{ github.sha }}

  publish:
    needs: [integration-tests, security-checks, docker-build]
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Publish to Registry
        run: |
          echo "Publishing artifacts..."
          # Placeholder for actual publishing logic
          echo "Artifacts published successfully"
```
